title: fix(app-shell): don't show recovery-password reminder on a user's first landing
body: RecoveryPasswordReminder fired on the env home on a brand-new SSO user's very first screen (before they've built anything) — premature friction on the first-run magic moment. The component already intends 'not before the first session' but the code didn't honor it. Gate on a first-visit localStorage marker: record the first home landing, show the reminder only from the next visit on. Still dismissible; preserves SSO-fallback resilience for default (password-allowed) envs. Follow-up: also gate off SSO-enforced envs where the password can't be used.
